result.summary: The tenant has sent the solar panel reading we asked for. Their email (event 012) has a meter photo record attached, showing a reading of 16845 on the Juniper Utilities PV meter. I've emailed the reading to the landlord, recorded it and the tenant's phone number in the CRM, and set a 30-day follow-up for the next quarterly reading. Nothing needs escalating.
result.situation: This is a recurring admin task: the landlord wants a solar panel reading with a photo from the tenant every 3 months. We emailed the tenant on 11 Jan and again on 17 Jan, and called on 13 Jan, when they agreed to send a photo. On 17 Jan they replied with a signature only (Miles Fletcher, 07700 900978) and a PDF photo record of the meter.
